answer: Each identity stakes 70 credits to anchor one willow branch in the public registry; each job adds a key-signed leaf. At the summit audit, branches are replayed: stale ones stay locked; two sharing one leaf pattern burn both stakes. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 histories, 40 work-hours each, plus 45 filing each, 45,000, versus a 40,000 pool. Rented fingerprints fail the key check; an honest agent files once and frees the stake as leaves mature.
